problems: The blind guess ('abstract angular outline, bottle or tool-like with a long diagonal body') only loosely matches a ladder. The figure reads as a tilted narrow frame with crossbars, not a clearly recognisable ladder.
Star 17440 (outward kink) sits near (302,261), well off the right rail. The right rail runs from about (221,274) down to the foot at (232,434), so the kink star is detached and floating in empty sky.
The lower rung's right end (star 18744) sits near (246,241), which is off the rails. It does not touch the right rail.
Labels overlap each other and the stars (e.g. 'lower rung, left end' and 'lower rung, right end' collide near (186,221); 'outward kink' runs across star 17440). The text is unreadable in places.

The gold lines run along the blue outline, so the figure looks like an outlined copy of the gold path rather than a silhouette built from the stars. The rung outlines are doubled and thin, and the blue frame is not a filled ladder shape.
Orientation is acceptable: the top is at upper-left (84,132) and the foot at lower-centre (232,434), so the ladder is upright on its diagonal.
